# Arthistory.GG

> > A comprehensive digital art history resource featuring detailed analyses of paintings from major movements and museums worldwide.

Arthistory.GG provides in-depth information about individual paintings spanning from the Dutch Golden Age through Impressionism and modern movements. The site covers works held in major institutions including the Metropolitan Museum of Art, Harvard Art Museums, and Art Institute of Chicago, with particular focus on artists like Paul Cézanne, François Boucher, Camille Pissarro, Pablo Picasso, and Henri Matisse.

## Key Topics

- Metropolitan Museum of Art
- Baroque
- Dutch Golden Age
- Realism
- Impressionism

## Major Art Movements

- [Are They Thinking about the Grape? (Pensent-ils au raisin?)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/are-they-thinking-about-the-grape-pensent-ils-au-raisin): François Boucher's 1747 Rococo pastoral painting for Louis XV court
- [A Washerwoman at Eragny](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-washerwoman-at-eragny): Pissarro's Impressionist rural life scene at Eragny, 1893
- [A Country Road](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-country-road): Dutch Golden Age landscape by Salomon van Ruysdael, Haarlem school
- [A Hare, Partridges, and Fruit](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-hare-partridges-and-fruit): Flemish Baroque hunting still life by Jan Fyt at Met Museum
- [A Female Martyr Saint](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-female-martyr-saint): Italian Baroque martyrdom painting by Nuvolone at Met Museum
- [Annunciation (1495)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/annunciation-1495): Northern Renaissance Annunciation by Jean Hey, Master of Moulins
- [A Shepherd](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-shepherd): Mannerist pastoral by Joachim Wtewael, Utrecht school Dutch art

## Paul Cézanne Works

- [Antoine Dominique Sauveur Aubert (born 1817), the Artist's Uncle](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/antoine-dominique-sauveur-aubert-born-1817-the-artists-uncle): Early Cézanne realist portrait of his uncle Antoine Aubert, 1866
- [Antoine Dominique Sauveur Aubert (born 1817), the Artist's Uncle, as a Monk](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/antoine-dominique-sauveur-aubert-born-1817-the-artists-uncle-as-a-monk): Cézanne's early realist portrait of uncle as monk, 1866 oil painting

## Portrait Paintings

- [Alexandre Charles Emmanuel de Crussol-Florensac (1743–1815)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/alexandre-charles-emmanuel-de-crussol-florensac-1743-1815): Vigée Le Brun's neoclassical portrait of French aristocrat, 1787
- [A Family Group](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-family-group-5bb15): Dutch Golden Age family portrait by Rembrandt pupil Nicolaes Maes
- [Abbott Lawrence Lowell (1856-1943)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/abbott-lawrence-lowell-1856-1943): Hopkinson's portrait of Harvard president Abbott Lawrence Lowell
- [Adele Lewisohn Lehman (1882-1965)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/adele-lewisohn-lehman-1882-1965): Contemporary realist portrait of philanthropist by Daniel Greene
- [A Gentleman of the Wilkes Family](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-gentleman-of-the-wilkes-family): Henry Inman's 19th-century American realist portrait at Met Museum

## American Landscape Painting

- [An Old Clearing](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/an-old-clearing): Tonalist landscape by Alexander H. Wyant, American atmospheric art
- [A Study of Trap Rock (Buttermilk Falls)](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-study-of-trap-rock-buttermilk-falls): Hudson River School geological realism at Buttermilk Falls by Hill

## Mythology and Classical Subjects

- [Andromache and Astyanax](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/andromache-and-astyanax): Prud'hon's neoclassical Greek mythology scene, maternal tenderness

## Optional

- [Bamboo, Blossoming Plum Branches, and Two Sparrows](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/bamboo-blossoming-plum-branches-and-two-sparrows): Asian ink painting with nature symbolism: bamboo, plum, sparrows
- [A warrior sits on a block and gestures; two figure are behind him, from Figurine series](https://www.arthistory.gg/painting/a-warrior-sits-on-a-block-and-gestures-two-figure-are-behind-him-from-figurine-series): Salvator Rosa Baroque etching from Figurine series at Art Institute
